Specification: A set of formal TLA+ proofs for the Boyer-Moore Majority Vote algorithm. It establishes technical lemmas about positions and occurrence counts, proves the type invariant, and verifies the final correctness property by demonstrating that the algorithm maintains a safety invariant across all valid state transitions.
IfThenElse: IF seq[j] = v THEN PositionsBefore(v,j) \union {j} ELSE PositionsBefore(v,j)
IF seq[j] = v THEN OccurrencesBefore(v,j) + 1 ELSE OccurrencesBefore(v,j)

AssumeProveBlocks: ASSUME NEW v, NEW j \in Int PROVE IsFiniteSet(PositionsBefore(v,j))
ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE PositionsBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN PositionsBefore(v,j) \union {j} ELSE PositionsBefore(v,j)
ASSUME TypeOK, NEW j \in 1 .. Len(seq), NEW v PROVE OccurrencesBefore(v, j+1) = IF seq[j] = v THEN OccurrencesBefore(v,j) + 1 ELSE OccurrencesBefore(v,j)
SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, Inv, Next PROVE Inv'
